svg.title: Side cut-aways on one base, animated: plates press down on a tall coil spring, a short multi-turn wave spring whose waves flatten, a stack of four disc springs facing each other whose cones flatten for more travel, and four nested disc springs that move only a little under a bigger push; then all spring back.

g.text: Squashing flattens the waves or the cones, so a short spring gives a strong push
